item.title: You Can Now Use Containers with Zephyr OS
item.description: Leveraging WebAssembly, Atym’s system offers container support that runs on top of the Zephyr RTOS.

item.title: Texas Instruments to Buy Silicon Labs in $7.5B Deal
item.description: TI said the tie-up with Silicon Labs positions it to be a leading provider of wireless connectivity solutions for the IoT.

item.title: Empower the Next Wave of Semiconductor Reuse Through Chiplet Realization
item.description: Unlock the future of semiconductor innovation with chiplets — enabling scalable, cost-effective designs and paving the way for a reusable chip marketplace.

item.title: 2025 PowerBest Award Winners: Power Device, Conversion, and Controller Products
item.description: Electronic Design's Lee Goldberg chronicles a year of powerful innovations with some of 2025's most notable developments in power devices, power conversion, and power management, plus a few surprises.

item.title: 2025 PowerBest Winners: Power Devices
item.description: The year 2025 produced a bumper crop of new SiC-, GaN-, and silicon-based power transistors, modules, and other basic building blocks for more robust, efficient, and versatile power applications.

item.title: 2025 PowerBest Winners: Power Conversion and Management
item.description: Higher levels of integration and ingenious power-conversion architectures are enabling simpler, denser, more efficient solutions for EVs, data centers, and other critical applications.

item.title: 2025 PowerBest Winners: Power Controllers
item.description: A wide of array of advanced controllers arrived in 2025, marked by high integration and enhanced intelligence in solutions involving USB and other technologies.

item.title: 2025 PowerBest Winners: Too Cool to Classify
item.description: Old is new again as tiny mechanical contactors outperform solid-state switches, monolithic inductors for power conversion, and powering Nixie tube displays.

item.title: AI Model Runs on 64 kB of RAM and a Zilog Z80 CPU
item.description: A developer came up with a way to run an AI tool on a Z80, with the goal of determining whether it can be trained and fine-tuned under extreme constraints.

item.title: Wrapping Up CES 2026
item.description: CES presented some interesting tech on the floor — and behind closed doors.
